about.heading: Thoughtful work, built end to end.
about.paragraph1: I hold a bachelor’s degree in Information Systems and worked as a developer at Kabul Polytechnic University, where I built the university website and management information system.
about.paragraph2: I now work as an Application Assistant at Islamic Bank of Afghanistan, contributing to internal applications and system support. I enjoy solving practical problems with clear, maintainable software.
